race.comment: RUPTURED (5) is a Hanseatic gelding from the stakes-winner Schism on debut for the Anthony & Sam Freedman yard. He's looked good at the trials leading in and sets up nicely for Jamie Mott from the low gate. FLYING WHITE ROBE (2) is a gelding by Trapeze Artist on debut for the Jerome Hunter yard. He's shown ability winning a jumpout and looks ready to go. CIRQUE DE COCO (7) just found one better first up here but ran well behind a smart winner and gets favours kicking up from the inside. EXCEED SONIC (1) can be an improver first up while OPTIMUS (4) is third up and will take plenty of catching up on speed.
